data.name: AlertScheduledRunFailedBody
data.value: The scheduled backup of the account {0} did not complete: {1} (code {2}). The account has no new copy from this run; the previous copies are kept.

data.name: AlertDestinationRefusedSubject
data.value: The scheduled backup of {0} could not reach its destination

data.name: AlertDestinationRefusedBody
data.value: The scheduled backup of the account {0} was not started because its destination refused it: {1} (code {2}). Check the destination in the backup settings; the next run is due at its usual time.

data.name: AlertScheduledRunMissedBody
data.value: A backup schedule was due at {0} UTC and did not start until {1} UTC, so the run at its named hour was missed. It covers: {2}. The panel was probably not running at that hour.
